summary: Unified match creation and report UI. Backend GET /api/v1/job-targets/{id} now enriches the target detail with the owning JD (title/company), the current JD version, and the default resume version summaries (batched single read in JobTargetUseCases._enrich). Frontend: typed match-assessments types/API module, MatchCreatePage (preselects target default versions, allows switching to any published version before submit, polls queued/evaluating, handles failed/timeout/retry/409/422), MatchReportPage (score gauge, 8 dimensions, caps, gap classes, evidence sufficiency with unverified-citation advisory, stale banner + rerun, actions: resume_optimization -> /builder/:draftId, plan -> /plans/new?resume_id=..., interview -> createInterview -> /interview/:id; low score never disables), JobTargetPage match-history list with cursor pagination + New assessment button, PlanCreatePage version-pinned params (job_target_id/jd_version_id/resume_version_id/match_assessment_id), App routes, en/zh i18n.

acceptance_mapping.ac: Add typed Match Assessment API/types and target match routes
acceptance_mapping.evidence: frontend/src/types/match-assessments.ts, frontend/src/api/match-assessments.ts, routes /targets/:id/match/new and /targets/:id/match/:assessmentId in App.tsx; backend enrichment test test_api_detail_enriches_job_and_pinned_versions

acceptance_mapping.ac: Chinese/English, component, build/lint, deep-link, and desktop/mobile browser checks pass

residual_risks: Browser acceptance deferred per reviews/20260805-browser-acceptance-waiver.md (no local playwright controller); lint/build/type checks green.
MatchCreatePage polling is client-driven (2s interval); no push updates. Worker outage surfaces as poll failure with refresh guidance.
